title: Data and code for: The contact face shapes band alignment and its predictability in Janus van der Waals heterostructures
description:
Data and code accompanying the manuscript The contact face shapes band alignment and its predictability in Janus van der Waals heterostructures (submitted to Nature Communications).

Contents: relaxed structures, face-resolved band edges and vacuum-level steps of 108 Janus X–A–M–Q monolayers on a biaxial strain grid; formation energies; DFT (PBE+D3(BJ)) geometries, layer-resolved band edges, band-edge layer weights and electrostatic interface dipoles of 832 heterostructures (599 in the fitting set); HSE06 and HSE06+SOC checks on monolayers and on six heterostructures; the contact-resolved linear-response model, its machine-learned correction and the localization classifier; blind-test predictions recorded before the DFT calculations; the predicted alignment map of 7 796 lattice-matched interfaces; the pre-registered transfer test; the relaxed structures and basic properties of a database of 1 328 Janus monolayers; the fine-tuned MACE model; and the scripts used to build the descriptors, fit the models and generate the figures.
